limitations: Cooperative limits cannot preempt kernel I/O/fsync stalls; external supervision remains necessary.
Local advisory locks are not cross-host fencing or hostile same-UID containment.
Original policy/configuration and source release must be supplied separately; no automatic path migration.
A failed publication can leave partial or complete unapproved output; never reuse or silently promote it.
Actual provider, signer, canonical state, off-host possession and operating release approval remain separate.

preexecution_corrections: Aggregate payload admission before file reads and publication; restore-plan headroom included.
Existing-only lock opens and guaranteed descriptor close on unlock failure.
Held inode checks before publication; no source lock recreation.
Explicit false lock-ownership/freshness flags; stale selected bundle integrity kept separate from package age.
Current observer pending history is not forced to equal an older selected-journal state.
Bounded destination readback precedes final manifest/plan; fresh lock privacy, emptiness and distinct inodes verified.
scope: Static line/function review of new unsigned tool only; not runtime evidence.
